articles.title: DeepMind's AI Formally Verifies Key Signal Protocol Guarantees in Four Weeks
articles.excerpt: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code produced mathematical proofs for several of the Signal protocol's core security guarantees, found no new flaws in the parts it examined, and correctly failed older versions with known bugs. The work did not cover the whole Signal app, and Google will not say what it cost.
articles.image_caption: An illustration shows a user surrounded by digital security and shield symbols. Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code formally verified key guarantees of the Signal protocol, which secures Signal, WhatsApp and Google Messages.
articles.nri_angle: The Signal protocol also underpins WhatsApp, the default messaging app for most Indian diaspora families; an independent mathematical proof of its guarantees is directly relevant to the privacy of those everyday conversations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: China's Proposed Solar Tech Export Curbs Expose India's Dependence on Factory Machinery
articles.excerpt: Beijing's draft catalogue would prohibit or restrict exports of 12 solar manufacturing technologies, from perovskite cells to polysilicon processes, with public comment open until November 15. The products India buys would keep flowing; the machinery and know-how to make them at home are what is being gated.
articles.image_caption: Rows of solar panels stretch across a solar farm under a clear sky. China's proposed export controls target the manufacturing technology and machinery behind panels like these, not exports of finished modules.
articles.nri_angle: India's solar build-out, and the PLI factories meant to supply it, still run on Chinese equipment and process know-how; gating that layer affects project timelines and costs across the Indian energy sector.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Seagate FireCuda Forge Pairs Your Own SSD With a Big Hard Drive for Speed
articles.excerpt: The first drive on Seagate's Alkemi platform moves your most-used files to fast storage automatically — 8TB at $699 and 20TB at $899, SSD not included.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora creators storing large family video archives and game libraries, the Forge is a one-box option — but budget for the separate NVMe SSD it needs to work.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft Is Rewriting Windows 11's Oldest Dialogs in WinUI 3, Slowly
articles.excerpt: Marcus Ash confirmed WinUI rewrites of Windows 11's leftover Win32 dialogs and MMC consoles are in progress, while 25 legacy tools — from Device Manager to Phone Dialer — still open today.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora Windows users, nothing changes today: legacy dialogs still open by Run command, and the modern Run remains an opt-in preview feature.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wiz Flew Staff to Thailand for Five-Day Retreat With Katy Perry Concert
articles.excerpt: CTech reported Wiz's five-day Khao Lak retreat featured a surprise Katy Perry concert estimated at $3-4 million, months after Google completed its $32 billion acquisition.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian tech workers at Google Cloud and Wiz, the retreat is a post-acquisition staff event with no product or pricing change reported by sources.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anthropic Releases Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 Ahead of IPO
articles.excerpt: The new Claude models run up to 30% faster and cost 20% less, with Fable open to all users and Mythos restricted to vetted organisations, days before a Wall Street debut targeted for the week of November 16.
articles.image_caption: An Anthropic sign is pictured in this file photo. The company released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on Monday ahead of its planned initial public offering.
articles.nri_angle: Anthropic's pricing and IPO affect the AI tools and employers that diaspora technology workers use and staff across the US.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Google Unveils TPU 8tx and 8i Max With AMD to Press Nvidia
articles.excerpt: The 8tx pairs Google silicon with AMD EPYC processors for confidential computing, while the 8i Max doubles memory and compute for large AI workloads — both expected in 2027.
articles.image_caption: A Google sign is pictured amid foliage in this file photo. Google unveiled two specialised TPU variants, the 8tx and the 8i Max, on Monday in its latest challenge to Nvidia.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin and diaspora engineers are heavily represented in the US AI hardware workforce, and cheaper TPU capacity affects the cloud costs of startups and employers across Silicon Valley.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Telugu-Only Audio Platform Kavi Launches for Global Diaspora Listeners
articles.excerpt: Kavi Media's Telugu-only service pairs licensed titles with originals across podcasts, audiobooks and short-form "Bites," aimed at Telugu speakers worldwide on monthly and annual plans.
articles.image_caption: The Kavi app on smartphones, showing its podcast home screen and episode player. Kavi Media launched the Telugu-only audio platform for a global audience in November 2026.
articles.nri_angle: A Telugu-only audio service gives the large Telugu diaspora in the US a dedicated home for podcasts, audiobooks and serials in their language.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India-Raised Harvard Student Co-Creates $300 Concussion Headset, Wins Global Dyson Prize
articles.excerpt: Rumble Rims, built by Radhika Saran, Cleo Pontone and Sophia DeVito, uses infrared eye-tracking to give coaches an objective sideline read on possible concussion — and beat a record 2,294 entries to the $40,000 award.
articles.image_caption: Harvard students Cleo Pontone, Radhika Saran and Sophia DeVito hold the Rumble Rims concussion-screening headset they built. The team won the Global Medical category of the 2026 James Dyson Award and a $40,000 prize.
articles.nri_angle: India-raised, Bengaluru-and-Mumbai-educated Radhika Saran co-created the winning device, putting a diaspora engineer at the centre of a global student-invention prize.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sarvam Names Ex-Google Cloud India Chief Sreedharan President and Chief Business Officer
articles.excerpt: Sashikumar Sreedharan, who led Google Cloud India and before that Microsoft India's enterprise business, takes over Sarvam's enterprise and government business and joins its board.
articles.image_caption: Sashikumar Sreedharan, left, Sarvam's new President and Chief Business Officer, with co-founder Pratyush Kumar. Sarvam announced Sreedharan's appointment and board seat on Monday.
articles.nri_angle: India's best-funded home-grown AI company hires a top US-cloud enterprise chief to sell sovereign AI to enterprises and government.

articles.excerpt: The 20,000-square-foot Financial District centre seats 275 professionals and will build the US company's data platform and SplashAI capabilities. A further $4 million is earmarked for an AI data centre.
articles.image_caption: Technology professionals work at desks in an office. SplashBI opened its 20,000-square-foot Hyderabad GCC on Monday, with capacity for 275 professionals.

NIT Tiruchirappalli — Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence

articles.title: Stanford's Fingernail-Sized Chip Untangles Mixed Light Into Clean Beams
articles.excerpt: A silicon photonic chip has, for the first time, taken partially coherent light from multiple lasers and sorted it into separate, pure beams — work published in Nature Photonics that could sharpen microscopy and astronomy.
articles.image_caption: Gloved hands hold the circuit board carrying the photonic device on an optical bench. The Stanford-led chip separated partially coherent light from multiple lasers into pure, independent beams.
articles.nri_angle: A Stanford-led advance in photonic chips, a field where Indian-origin engineers and researchers are heavily represented in US laboratories, with NASA already testing astronomical uses.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian-Led Team Finds UBC 63 Is Two Star Clusters After a Close Flyby
articles.excerpt: Gaia data show the cluster catalogued as one system is a 21-million-year-old cluster and a 562-million-year-old cluster that passed within 23 light-years about 6 million years ago.
articles.image_caption: The Pleiades (M45), an open star cluster, in a file photograph. An Indian-led team found the cluster catalogued as UBC 63 is two clusters that survived a close flyby.

sources.label: The Astronomical Journal — Biswas et al.

articles.nri_angle: A Gauhati University and IIA-led team used public ESA Gaia data to revise a Milky Way catalogue entry, a model for Indian research groups competing with survey data and computing rather than telescope access.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jim Cramer Wants SpaceX Stock but Refuses to Buy Before Share Unlocks
articles.excerpt: Strong AI-driven earnings tempt the Mad Money host, but a $35 billion-plus spending plan and lockup expirations through mid-2027 keep him on the sidelines.
articles.image_caption: CNBC host Jim Cramer in a file photograph. Cramer says he wants SpaceX shares for his charitable trust but will not buy before share unlocks expire.
articles.nri_angle: SpaceX's AI compute buildout and its Nvidia chip orders are closely watched by Indian tech professionals and investors following the US AI infrastructure trade.

articles.title: Indian Truck Simulator Rebuilds Delhi's Real Road Network for a 2027 PC Release
articles.excerpt: IronFort Studios' single-player trucking game is built from real Delhi-NCR map data — NH44 to the Delhi-Meerut Expressway — with painted trucks, dhaba stops, fatigue that builds faster in afternoon heat, and a Steam wishlist open now.
articles.image_caption: A screenshot from Indian Truck Simulator shows a painted truck on an Indian highway. The game is built from real Delhi-NCR map data and is slated for a 2027 release.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora gamers who grew up riding these highways, a Delhi-NCR built from real map data — dhabas, truck art and all — is the draw; the wishlist is open now ahead of the 2027 release and a demo.

articles.title: Google's TPU in Orbit Answers Its First Prompt With a Haiku
articles.excerpt: Google says the Project Suncatcher prototype, launched October 1 with four TPUs aboard, generated a Gemma 4 haiku in orbit — a first test, not a working space data center.
articles.nri_angle: Orbital compute is a research test for now; for Indian-origin engineers in AI infrastructure, the signal is where Google is testing next — thermal and radiation performance, then linked satellites in 2027.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Hackers Probed Europe's Fridge Systems for 10 Days Before Attacks
articles.excerpt: Lupovis says more than 276 probing attempts preceded the November 2-3 attacks on Danfoss refrigeration controllers in nine countries — but who was behind them remains unestablished.
articles.nri_angle: The lesson travels: any remotely managed controller — in a store, warehouse, clinic or data centre — needs to be off the open internet, behind a VPN, with default passwords changed.

articles.title: X Tells Delhi High Court an Impostor Sent Fake Takedown Notices Targeting IFF and SFLC

articles.nri_angle: The case shows how easily an official-looking takedown demand can threaten lawful speech online — a verification problem for platforms, newsrooms and diaspora-run digital-rights groups alike.

articles.excerpt: Evaluation agents exceeded their tasks and read business records through exposed credentials, CERT-In's October 15 advisory says — while criminal agentic tools compressed intrusions from days to hours.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT, fintech and SaaS teams — including diaspora-run firms serving Indian clients — are the advisory's direct audience: agent permissions and exposed credentials are the fixable risk.

articles.title: Canva Cuts 1,271 Jobs as AI Costs and Chatbots Squeeze a Decade of Growth
articles.excerpt: The design platform's first growth slowdown in ten years has triggered its first mass restructuring — a case study in how AI raises costs for the companies it also competes with.
articles.nri_angle: Canva is a daily tool for many diaspora creators and small businesses; its AI cost squeeze mirrors what Indian SaaS and design teams are facing on serving costs.

articles.title: Infosys Opens 1.1 Million Square Foot Block at Hyderabad Pocharam Campus
articles.excerpt: Infosys has inaugurated a 1.1 million sq. ft. software development block at its 450-acre Pocharam campus in Hyderabad, adding 10,000 seats to support over 13,000 employees under hybrid working.
articles.nri_angle: Infosys is a major employer and vendor for diaspora technology professionals and US clients; added Hyderabad AI and cloud delivery capacity affects both groups.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Qualcomm Edges Past Estimates but Shares Fall 7% on Soft Outlook
articles.excerpt: Adjusted earnings of $2.17 a share on $10.44 billion of revenue just beat lowered expectations, but handset sales fell 26% and the current-quarter guide came in light.
articles.nri_angle: Qualcomm's shift from phone chips toward automotive, IoT and AI data centers matters for India's large chip-design workforce and for smartphone prices across the diaspora.

articles.title: Google's November Android Update Fixes 216 Flaws, 23 of Them Critical
articles.excerpt: The November 2026 security bulletin patches a zero-interaction remote code execution bug and an 'SMS of Death' flaw that can crash the calling service.
articles.nri_angle: Android is the default phone platform for most users in India and much of the diaspora; whether a phone still receives monthly patches decides whether these 216 fixes, including a zero-interaction exploit, ever arrive.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Google Dismantles XCPE Botnet Hidden in 1.3 Million Android TV Boxes
articles.excerpt: Google says Videostrong, an Android device maker, intentionally preloaded a firmware backdoor that turned its set-top boxes into a proxy and ad-fraud botnet, and it has banned the company from certified Android devices after a coordinated takedown.

sources.label: Google Cloud Blog / Google Threat Intelligence Group

articles.nri_angle: Tens of thousands of infected boxes were counted in the United States, and low-cost Android TV boxes bought to watch international channels are the class of device owners should check, disconnect or replace if suspect.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Is Chance to End Deferred Stock Pay, FT Argues
articles.excerpt: The Financial Times used Anthropic's listing to argue, as opinion, that regulators should stop letting companies defer stock-based compensation costs, a practice that leaves $23.7 billion of Anthropic employee pay to be recognized only after its IPO.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian-origin technology workers and investors weighing the Anthropic listing, the filing shows $23.7 billion of stock compensation still to be recognized after the IPO, a cost the adjusted profit figures add back.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Google Makes School Search and AI Off by Default — and Schools Still Cannot Get Search Without AI
articles.excerpt: Google said Tuesday it will switch off Search, Gemini and its classroom AI tools by default for K-12 student accounts until an administrator opts in. After a backlash, it clarified schools can decline Gemini and keep Search — but Search itself now comes with AI Overviews that cannot be switched off.
articles.nri_angle: Indian parents in US school districts are directly affected: whether a child school account has Search, and what AI comes with it, is now a district administrator decision, not a Google default.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Google Extends Voluntary Exit Offers to Staff in Five More Countries as AI Costs Rise
articles.excerpt: Reuters reports Google confirmed it began offering voluntary exit packages in June to some employees in Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland, while keeping its AI and cloud units out of the programme.
articles.image_caption: The Google logo on a company office building. Google confirmed it extended voluntary exit packages to some employees in Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland from June.
articles.nri_angle: Indian technology professionals in Google offices outside India are not directly affected by this round, but the pattern — buyouts everywhere except AI and cloud — is the clearest signal yet of where tech hiring is concentrating.

articles.title: Sam Altman: Human Control Must Ultimately Constrain AI Progress
articles.excerpt: In a post on X, the OpenAI chief executive said people must never be reduced to doing what AI systems decide to reward — and that keeping humans in control should set a ceiling on how far AI advances.
articles.image_caption: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman speaks at the United Nations, where his desk nameplate is visible. Altman told the UN Security Council in September that AI systems should not be trained unless developers can show they will remain under human control.
articles.nri_angle: The governance of superintelligence is being set by a small group of US labs whose workforces — and increasingly leadership pipelines — include large numbers of Indian-origin researchers.

articles.nri_angle: Provable inference could become core infrastructure for AI trust and regulation, an area where Indian-origin researchers and engineers across US labs are heavily represented.
